title: ObjectConnectorCoordinateSpringDamperExt: the analytic Jacobian ignores factor0 and factor1
author: Claude-JG
description: Without friction, limit stops and user function, ObjectConnectorCoordinateSpringDamperExt declares its analytic Jacobian, stiffness*factorODE2 + damping*factorODE2_t chained with the marker Jacobians; its force acts with factor1 and -factor0 on the markers and depends on factor1*q1 - factor0*q0, so the Jacobian lacks factor_i*factor_k. Found in coordinateSpringDamperExt.py (the gear pair, factor1 = -rad0/rad1): the Jacobian differs from the numerical one by 1.3e5, and with forODE2Connectors the model needs 1409 instead of 4780 Newton iterations (the result differs by 2 percent, the friction of the other connectors follows another path). Decided: the Jacobian follows the factors - on the connector interface, where ComputeConnectorForcesCoordinate already has them (revision2026c step RG9.11.8), or by the factors in ComputeJacobianODE2_ODE2.
releaseNotes: ObjectConnectorCoordinateSpringDamperExt computes its Jacobian by local numerical differentiation of its forces on both markers, with factor0 and factor1; the analytic Jacobian, which ignored the factors, is removed.
